rationale: Cribl's official docs describe Copilot Editor for creating/editing data-transformation pipelines and state Cribl AI is native across supported products. This supports current AI functionality associated with the Stream pipeline, but source date, exact Edge/Stream version and deployment/provider availability are not established; keep binary weak/forced. The functional core remains useful without AI.
ai_type_rationale: Telemetry collection, reduction, enrichment, normalization and routing remain meaningful without Copilot; AI augments this core.
version_scope: No version/date. Current official docs show capabilities and provider/deployment dependence, not historical availability in source version.
issues: Undated source; AI availability varies by deployed product and requires a configured provider. Group combines Edge and Stream as in frozen input.

sources.excerpt: Copilot Editor: Helps you create and edit data transformation Pipelines. ... Cribl AI is a native part of the Cribl product suite. ... No AI provider is configured. AI feature entry points stay visible, but they aren’t operational until you configure a provider.
sources.applicability: Official current suite documentation establishes pipeline AI assistance, with provider and product/deployment caveats; historical applicability unknown.
